newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Healthsource rating affirmed.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Healthsource rating affirmed.

text.p: -- Chicago Corp Wednesday added Healthsource Inc to its Priority List and affirmed its buy rating for the stock.
-- Analysts Peter Costa and Bruce Cranna said they expect Healthsource to hold costs flat in fiscal 1997, while new cost-saving initiatives help the company post higher earnings.
-- Healthsource is the HMO best-positioned to build on its presence in the southwestern United States, the analysts said, in a market dominated by managed fee-for-service indemnity insurance.
-- Healthsource is a health maintenance organization management company. Shares were up one-1/4 at 13-1/8.
